description: Refy wordmark and symbol with sizes and display variants.

howToUse: Use it for the refy brand in headers, footers and splash screens.
Use `markOnly` where only the symbol fits, and `tone` for dark or light backgrounds. The symbol takes the main color of the theme.
For your product's brand, pass it in `brand` with an `aria-label` that names it.
alternatives: A person or company in a list: Avatar.

keyboard.action: The logo does not receive focus. When it links to the home page, the link receives it.

props.name: symbol
props.description:
The refy symbol before the word. The word's shape and font are fixed in any theme;
the symbol color comes from the theme's `--brand-mark` token.

props.name: height
props.description: Exact height of the logo in px, for headers with a fixed slot. Overrides `size`; with `symbol` the symbol is this tall.

props.name: children
props.description: Brand provided by the consumer. Refy includes no third-party assets.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
